question: LOCAL DIAGNOSTIC (amendment-1, non-admitted, never a leaderboard row): on Weil-descended m=3 Semaev decomposition systems for the Koblitz curve K1: y^2+xy=x^3+x^2+1 over GF(2^17) (#E = 2*65587, r = 65587), factor base = nonzero abscissae in V=<1,z,...,z^4> (l=5), how do msolve F4 (-g 2 + in-house root extraction), CryptoMiniSat 5 with native XOR in full-enumeration mode, and the repository's incumbent inherited-f4 engine (on the same Boolean system) compare in verified relations per CPU-second, judged against an exhaustive factor-base oracle, and how far is each arm's cost per relation from the matched repository Pollard rho on the same curve, with every arm priced across the §5a band?

claims.text: Every relation counted for any arm is an abscissa multiset {x1,x2,x3} of nonzero factor-base abscissae such that some sign choice gives P1+P2+P3 = ±R, established by group re-addition on the curve (semaev.readdition semantics, memoised per (target, multiset)); a Boolean root that does not project to such a multiset is a spurious root, counted per arm and never a relation. The arm's verified relation set per target must equal the fb-enum oracle's set for that target.

Per target and arm: native work units (msolve: sum over F4 rounds of rows x cols from the -v 2 'mat' column, plus max step degree and largest matrix; CMS: propagations and conflicts from --verb 1 final statistics, plus Gauss-Jordan matrix activation lines; inherited-f4: SolverCost.ops word XORs and degree_reached), solver CPU (wait4 rusage of the solver child), solver-internal timer (msolve 'overall(cpu)', CMS 'Total time'), wall and peak memory (cgroup memory.peak, else VmHWM). Recorded observations of this run, not properties of the systems.

In the one cell, which of two available solver arms (all on the same Boolean system) uses less charged CPU per natural target (stratified), at Bonferroni-corrected significance and outside the A/A noise floor of both arms. Diagnostic tier only (local shared VM, no PMU, no L2).

Per available arm, cost per verified relation and the projected relation phase ((fb_abscissae + 10) = 24 relations; linear algebra, target generation, encoding and projection uncharged, so an IC lower bound) relative to the matched rho, reported as distance remaining (log2) at w = 0, 0.1, 1 GAE per unpriced native op on BOTH sides and at the same-host clock. Verdict vocabulary excludes 'below matched rho' (not every IC phase is priced); only 'above matched rho at every reading' or 'unresolved in band'.

Observed max F4 step degree (msolve) and degree_reached (inherited-f4) are compared descriptively with the Boolean semi-regular degree from the series (1+t)^v / prod_i (1+t^{d_i}) (field equations included; replaces dreg_forecast::semi_regular_degree_field, which is the no-field-equation series; red-team M9). No law is claimed.

Not established: any improvement over the IC baseline or any leaderboard/benchmarks-README row (local, non-admitted, no replay certificate, no VALIDATION.json); any timing beyond this container; any scaling in n; any statement for the symmetrised or symmetrised-e encodings (dropped, see amendment); Magma (UNAVAILABLE: not available to the owner); trace-f4/julia-f4-warm (UNAVAILABLE: Julia absent, download host proxy-blocked); msolve 0.11 SIMD build (not provisioned in this container); repo-boolean-f4 (dropped, red-team H1).

arms.description: msolve 0.6.5 (/usr/bin/msolve, sha256 pinned) `-g 2 -v 2 -t 1` on the plain chained-S3 encoding with field equations; ALL roots of the reduced DRL basis extracted in-house (certificate.basis_roots; extraction CPU charged to this arm as extract_cpu_s and reported separately; extraction limit overflow = censored, not unknown). msolve's own GF(2) solving output is never used. Native unit: F4 matrix cells = sum over rounds of rows x cols ('mat' column of -v 2).

parameters.native_unit: F4 matrix cells (sum rows*cols over rounds)

arms.description: A/A: the identical msolve-f4 call on the identical target, pass B (reversed within-target arm order, run immediately after pass A on the same worker).

CryptoMiniSat 5.11.15 (/usr/bin/cryptominisat5, sha256 pinned) on the extended-DIMACS encoding of the SAME Boolean system (Tseitin AND per nonlinear monomial, native XOR rows), `--threads 1 --random 0 --verb 1 --maxsol 1000000` = full enumeration until UNSAT (C1); default Gauss-Jordan options (--maxmatrixrows 2000 --maxmatrixcols 1000 --autodisablegauss 1) kept and every call's '[matrix] Good matrix' / 'Using N matrices' lines recorded (M5); a call with 0 matrices is flagged, not re-run. Every call charged. Native unit: propagations (conflicts recorded beside).
A/A: the identical cms-xor call (same seed 0) on the identical target in pass B. Measures the clock noise floor of a deterministic enumeration, not seed sensitivity.

Incumbent (red-team H1): the repository's inherited-f4 SystemSolver (ic_framework::solvers::HybridF4, kind InheritedF4; the Koblitz decomposition oracle's engine, incumbent of research/m4gb_descent_ladder_20261110) on the SAME plain chained-S3 Boolean system as the other arms, no re-encoding, through examples/gc_native_solve.rs (op 'solve', engine defaults max_degree 3, split auto, node_budget 4096) and groebner_compare/native_worker.py (prerequisite PA-3). Every returned root goes through the same re-addition projection. A run that hits the node budget is 'unknown' and is classified censored (charged at its CPU, flagged), never 'no root'. Native unit: word XORs (SolverCost.ops). AVAILABILITY-GATED on PA-1 (the crate builds) and PA-3; recorded UNAVAILABLE with its reason if either fails, never substituted.
A/A: the identical inherited-f4 call on the identical target in pass B.

Ground truth (C1): exhaustive enumeration of every 3-multiset (repetition allowed) of the 14 factor-base abscissae with every sign pattern by group addition, building the table x_R -> set of decomposing multisets for the whole cell once (prerequisite P2). Defines oracle_count and the oracle relation set of every target. Also reported as a descriptive row (H1: 'rank fb-enum as a row'): table-build CPU and group additions, amortised per relation found in the table; not part of the decisive family because it answers all targets at once.

Matched rho (C2): the repository's signed-Frobenius rho (koblitz_index_calculus::koblitz_signed_frobenius_rho_with_progress, step-identical to koblitz_signed_frobenius_rho_reference) on KoblitzCurve::new(1,17) (r = 65587), 1000 random subgroup DLPs from the protocol seed rule, run locally in this container; reports expected steps rho_expected_steps(65587,17) = sqrt(pi r/2)/sqrt(2n) = 55.05, measured mean walk group additions, every unpriced per-step counter (partition hashes, canonicalisations) and CPU per DLP; plus t_GA = same-process CPU seconds per FastCurve group addition (best of 7 batches of 10^6). Prerequisite PA-2. AVAILABILITY-GATED on PA-1.

5 planted targets (semaev.generate, m=3 FB points with distinct abscissae, x_R outside V) run first through every available arm in both passes. Every complete arm must return the planted multiset among its verified relations (5/5).

The UNSAT stratum (oracle_count = 0 natural targets, 80) plus 2 tampered witnesses per arm (one bit of a returned root flipped at a protocol-hash-derived index; the projection must reject it or map it to a different multiset that the oracle rejects). Any verified relation on an oracle-empty target or an accepted tampered witness invalidates the arm.

positive.expected_detection: Each available complete arm returns the planted abscissa multiset as a re-addition-verified relation on 5/5 planted targets in both passes. A miss that is not censored invalidates the arm (instrument fault), reported, never dropped.

null_population.why_n: 80 UNSAT-stratum targets are both the negative control and the UNSAT stratum of the stratified estimator; specificity is zero-tolerance, so every one is used.

Natural stream q='natural', i = 0,1,2,...: x = SHA-256 counter stream keyed by the seed reduced mod 2^17, rejected unless x >= 2^5 (outside V) and liftable; sign bit from the same stream; each accepted target is labelled by the oracle and appended to its stratum until both strata hold 80 (later draws of a full stratum are discarded and logged). Planted q='planted', i=0..4: semaev.generate(3,17,5,variant='plain',a=1,b=1,seed=seed,index=0). Warm-up q='warmup', i=0 (discarded). Target processing order and Williams-sequence assignment q='order'. Tamper bit index q='tamper:<arm>:<k>'. Rho DLPs q='rho', i=0..999. Bootstrap RNG seed q='bootstrap'. power.note: Decisive test per pipeline pair: exact (or normal-approximation with tie correction) two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on the paired per-target log2 of charged CPU (mean of passes A and B), over the 160 natural targets, stratum-pooled, with a stratified sign check reported beside it. Family = 3 pipeline pairs x 1 cell; threshold 0.05/3 = 0.0167. Pairs where both arms are censored drop out of the test AND the bootstrap (red-team H4). n_eff >= 6 needed for 2/2^n < 0.0167; fewer gives 'unresolved'. Effect size: median paired log2 ratio and the stratified rel_per_cpu_s ratio, each with a 20000-resample stratified paired bootstrap CI.

primary.name: Verified relations per CPU-second (stratified)
primary.definition: Per arm: p_sat * mean_SAT(verified relations per target) / (p_sat * mean_SAT(charged CPU) + (1 - p_sat) * mean_UNSAT(charged CPU)), p_sat = exact oracle weight of the cell (1757/65572 at dev computation; P2 recomputes). Verified relations per target = size of the arm's re-addition-verified relation set (all distinct multisets, not 'at least one'; red-team H2). Charged CPU = solver child user+sys (wait4 rusage) + in-house root extraction CPU (msolve) + nothing else for any arm; a censored call is charged at the cap. Projection/re-addition CPU is recorded per arm and reported in a secondary reading, excluded here for every arm alike. Both passes averaged per target. A second reading uses the tool-internal timer (msolve overall(cpu), CMS Total time) with startup excluded (M6).
primary.source: rows.jsonl natural rows: stratum, verified_relations, status, solver_cpu_s, extract_cpu_s, internal_cpu_s

primary.name: Projected relation phase vs matched rho across the §5a band
primary.formula: C_arm(w) = (24 / rel_rate_per_target) * w * N_arm  [native ops per target, stratified mean; no priced group additions in any solver arm], C_rho(w) = A_rho + w * U_rho [A_rho measured mean walk group additions per DLP, U_rho measured mean unpriced per-step ops per DLP]; ratio_w = C_arm(w)/C_rho(w) for w in {0, 0.1, 1}; ratio_clock = (24 * charged CPU per verified relation) / (measured rho CPU per DLP); expected-ops reading uses E_steps = 55.05 in place of A_rho.
primary.definition: C3: the band applies to every arm. Native unit per arm: msolve = F4 matrix cells; CMS = propagations; inherited-f4 = word XORs; fb-enum = group additions (priced 1 GAE); rho = walk group additions (priced 1 GAE) + partition hashes and canonicalisations (unpriced, w). Because solver arms perform no priced group additions, C_arm(0) = 0 and no solver arm can be 'above at every reading'; the band therefore resolves nothing for solvers by construction and this is reported as such. The clock ratio is reported as 'diagnostic, IC lower bound'. Missing fields fail closed (no default u = 0; red-team C3).

This run is a LOCAL DIAGNOSTIC on a shared 4-vCPU VM without PMU or L2 isolation (owner 2026-11-17: AWS does not work), so every clock-based verdict is labelled diagnostic tier, read only against the same-session A/A floor, and never reaches the IC leaderboard or benchmarks/README.md.

stopping_rules.rule: 1 cell x (1 warm-up + 5 planted + 80 SAT + 80 UNSAT natural targets) x passes A,B x every available pipeline, 2 tamper checks per arm, rho 1000 DLPs, t_GA, startup baselines. No extension or early stop on results.

Per call: RLIMIT_CPU 60 s on the solver child (SIGXCPU/SIGKILL = censored, rusage from wait4 kept, msolve log parsed for degree reached) and 4 GiB memory (per-call cgroup memory.max if writable, else RLIMIT_AS; OOM = censored, never 'infrastructure failure', never retried; red-team H3). Identical for every arm. Root-extraction overflow (certificate limits) = censored. Censored calls are charged at the 60 s cap and kept (lower bound). No arm-cell is stopped for censoring: all targets run (red-team H4); a pipeline with >= 50% censored calls is reported 'censored at cap' with directional verdicts ('A < cap; B censored') where applicable. Cost guard decided on control cost only, before any natural target: if the planted phase (all arms, both passes) projects a total wall above 100 min, the natural sample is reduced symmetrically to the largest N per stratum (minimum 40) whose projection fits, identically for every arm, and the reduction is logged. Whole-run wall ceiling 105 min: on reaching it no new target starts, running targets finish both passes, all rows kept, the run is reported truncated with the number of complete target pairs.

Invalidates the arm (rows kept, status invalid, reported): a verified relation on an oracle-empty target; an accepted tampered witness; for a complete arm on a non-censored call, a verified relation set different from the oracle set (missing or extra multiset); a 'no relation' answer (basis {1}, UNSAT, empty) on an oracle-SAT target whose oracle multiset is a root of the encoded system (M1, applied to every arm alike); a planted miss that is not censored; a binary/ldd/harness hash mismatch; differing native op counts between passes for a deterministic arm. Spurious roots (not projecting to a relation) never invalidate; they are counted (C1).

Run blocked, not substituted: if PA-1..PA-5 are not met, the affected arm is UNAVAILABLE (inherited-f4, rho-matched) or the run does not start (oracle, driver, analysis). Without rho-matched, C-vs-rho is not reported at all.

decision_rule.text: Solver order: for each registered pipeline pair, two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-target paired log2 charged CPU (mean of passes A and B) over natural targets, both-censored pairs dropped; 'A uses less CPU per target' only if p < 0.05/3 AND |median paired log2 ratio| exceeds the larger |bound| of the 95% bootstrap intervals of BOTH arms' A/A (pass A vs pass B) log2 ratios; otherwise 'within A/A noise or not significant'; n_eff < 6 'unresolved'. A/A pairs and the registered comparisons are hard-coded, not supplied at unblinding (M3). Rho: per arm, 'above matched rho at every reading' only if ratio > 1 at w = 0, 0.1, 1 and at the clock; else 'unresolved in band'; log2 distance always reported, never pass/fail. Every verdict carries 'diagnostic tier (local, non-admitted)'. Unregistered pairs (e.g. aa vs other) get no verdict.
decision_rule.threshold: Bonferroni 0.05/3 and outside the A/A floor of both arms
decision_rule.statistic: Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired log2 charged CPU per target; stratified rate ratio for rel_per_cpu_s
decision_rule.interval: stratified paired bootstrap (resample targets within stratum), 20000 resamples, 95% and Bonferroni-level intervals; implemented in the pinned analysis script (M3)
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: median paired log2 CPU ratio; ratio of stratified rel_per_cpu_s
verdict_vocabulary: A uses less CPU per target
within A/A noise or not significant
above matched rho at every reading
